04 / BEFORE YOU PLAY

BEFORE
YOU START.

What challenges can I expect? +

Programming, logic, and reverse coding challenges, all against the clock.

What if I don’t have a team yet? +

Select “I’m coming solo” in the form. The organisers will share details about how teams will be formed.

When and where is ARENA 26? +

The organisers will announce the date and venue. We’ll add them here as soon as they’re confirmed.

Will transport be available? +

You can request transport in the form. Availability and departure points are still to be confirmed by the organisers.
